column2:
eccentric(adj./n.)古怪的、怪人
eccentricity(n.)古怪、怪癖
eccentric behavior 古怪的行為
an eccentric old man 古怪的老人
The eccentric artist always wears a purple hat, even at dinner.
(那位古怪的藝術家總是戴著紫色帽子，連吃晚餐時也不例外。)
His eccentric behavior made his neighbors curious about his past.
(他古怪的舉動讓鄰居對他的過去感到好奇。)

eclipse(n./v.)日蝕、月蝕、使黯然失色
(無詞性變化)
solar eclipse 日蝕
lunar eclipse 月蝕
Thousands of people gathered to watch the total solar eclipse.
(數千人聚集觀看日全蝕。)
Her success was soon eclipsed by her younger sister's achievements.
(她的成就很快就被妹妹的成就比下去了。)

edible(adj.)可食用的
inedible(adj.)不可食用的
edible mushrooms 可食用的菇類
edible oil 食用油
Not all wild mushrooms are edible, so never pick them without an expert.
(並非所有野菇都能吃，所以沒有專家陪同千萬別採。)
The cake was decorated with edible flowers from the garden.
(這個蛋糕用花園裡的食用花裝飾。)

editorial(adj./n.)編輯的、社論
editor(n.)編輯
edit(v.)編輯
editorial board 編輯委員會
newspaper editorial 報紙社論
The newspaper published an editorial criticizing the new tax policy.
(這份報紙刊登了一篇批評新稅制的社論。)
She joined the editorial team of the school magazine this year.
(她今年加入了校刊的編輯團隊。)

electrician(n.)電工、電氣技師
electric(adj.)電的
electricity(n.)電
call an electrician 叫電工
licensed electrician 合格電工
We called an electrician to fix the faulty wiring in the kitchen.
(我們請電工來修理廚房有問題的電線。)
Only a licensed electrician should install the new lights.
(只有合格的電工才能安裝新的燈具。)

elevate(v.)提升、抬高、使晉升
elevation(n.)海拔、提升
elevator(n.)電梯
elevate the status 提升地位
elevated highway 高架道路
Good music can elevate your mood after a stressful day.
(好的音樂能在壓力大的一天後提振你的心情。)
The village sits at an elevation of 2,000 meters above sea level.
(這個村莊位於海拔兩千公尺處。)

emigrant(n.)(移出的)移民、移居外國者
emigrate(v.)移居外國
emigration(n.)移居外國
Taiwanese emigrants 臺灣移民
an emigrant family 移民家庭
Many emigrants left Europe for America in the nineteenth century.
(十九世紀時，許多移民離開歐洲前往美洲。)
The emigrants struggled to adapt to the language and culture of their new home.
(這些移民努力適應新家園的語言和文化。)

emigrate(v.)移居外國
emigrant(n.)移民
emigration(n.)移居外國
emigrate to 移民到…
emigrate from 從…移出
His family emigrated to Canada when he was ten years old.
(他十歲時全家移民到加拿大。)
Many young people emigrate in search of better job opportunities.
(許多年輕人為了尋找更好的工作機會而移居國外。)

emigration(n.)移居外國、移民出境
emigrate(v.)移居外國
mass emigration 大規模移民
emigration policy 移民出境政策
The war led to a wave of mass emigration from the region.
(戰爭導致該地區出現一波大規模移民潮。)
Emigration has caused a shortage of skilled workers in the country.
(人口外移導致該國缺乏技術工人。)

encyclopedia(n.)百科全書
encyclopedic(adj.)百科全書式的、知識淵博的
online encyclopedia 線上百科全書
a walking encyclopedia 活百科
Before the internet, students looked up facts in a printed encyclopedia.
(在網路出現之前，學生在紙本百科全書中查資料。)
My grandfather knows so much that we call him a walking encyclopedia.
(我爺爺懂得很多，我們稱他為活百科。)

endeavor(n./v.)努力、嘗試、致力
(無詞性變化)
endeavor to 努力去…
human endeavor 人類的努力
We will endeavor to answer all your questions within two days.
(我們會盡力在兩天內回覆你所有的問題。)
Space exploration is one of the greatest human endeavors.
(太空探索是人類最偉大的努力之一。)

endowment(n.)捐贈、捐款、天賦
endow(v.)捐贈、賦予
be endowed with 天生具有…
endowment fund 捐贈基金
The university received a large endowment from a wealthy alumnus.
(這所大學收到一位富有校友的大筆捐款。)
She is endowed with a remarkable talent for languages.
(她天生具有非凡的語言天分。)

endurance(n.)耐力、忍耐力
endure(v.)忍受、持續
endurable(adj.)可忍受的
physical endurance 體力、耐力
beyond endurance 忍無可忍
Long-distance swimming requires great strength and endurance.
(長距離游泳需要很強的力量和耐力。)
The noise from the construction site was beyond endurance.
(工地傳來的噪音令人忍無可忍。)

enhance(v.)提高、增強、enhancement(n.)提高、增強
(無詞性變化)
enhance the quality 提升品質
enhance one's image 提升形象
Reading widely can enhance your writing skills and vocabulary.
(廣泛閱讀能提升你的寫作能力和字彙量。)
The new software brought a great enhancement to image quality.
(新軟體大幅提升了影像品質。)

enlighten(v.)啟發、開導、enlightenment(n.)啟發、啟蒙
enlightening(adj.)有啟發性的
the Enlightenment 啟蒙運動
spiritual enlightenment 心靈啟發
The documentary enlightened me about the problem of ocean pollution.
(這部紀錄片讓我了解海洋汙染的問題。)
The Enlightenment changed the way Europeans thought about reason and freedom.
(啟蒙運動改變了歐洲人對理性與自由的看法。)

enrich(v.)使豐富、使富裕、enrichment(n.)豐富、充實
(無詞性變化)
enrich one's life 豐富人生
enrichment program 增廣課程
Traveling abroad can greatly enrich your understanding of other cultures.
(出國旅行能大大豐富你對其他文化的了解。)
The school offers enrichment programs in art and science after class.
(學校在課後提供藝術與科學的增廣課程。)

enroll(v.)註冊、入學、登記、enrollment(n.)註冊、入學人數
(無詞性變化)
enroll in 註冊參加…
student enrollment 學生人數
She enrolled in an online course to learn basic programming.
(她報名了一門線上課程來學習基礎程式設計。)
Student enrollment has dropped because of the low birth rate.
(由於少子化，學生入學人數下降了。)

equalize(v.)使相等、使平等、扳平比分
equal(adj.)相等的
equality(n.)平等
equalize opportunities 使機會平等
equalize the score 扳平比分
The government hopes to equalize educational opportunities in rural areas.
(政府希望讓偏鄉的教育機會更平等。)
Our team equalized the score just two minutes before the end.
(我們隊在比賽結束前兩分鐘扳平了比分。)

equate(v.)把…等同、使相等
equation(n.)方程式、等同
equate A with B 把A等同於B
solve an equation 解方程式
Many people wrongly equate wealth with happiness.
(許多人錯誤地把財富等同於幸福。)
You should not equate good grades with true intelligence.
(你不應該把好成績和真正的聰明畫上等號。)

escort(n./v.)護送者、護衛隊、護送、陪同
(無詞性變化)
police escort 警察護送
escort sb. to 護送某人到…
The singer arrived at the stadium under police escort.
(那位歌手在警察護送下抵達體育場。)
A staff member escorted the visitors to the meeting room.
(一位工作人員陪同訪客前往會議室。)

esteem(n./v.)尊重、尊敬、認為
self-esteem(n.)自尊心
hold sb. in high esteem 非常尊敬某人
low self-esteem 自卑、缺乏自信
The doctor is held in high esteem by everyone in the village.
(那位醫生受到村裡每個人的高度尊敬。)
Praise from teachers can help build students' self-esteem.
(老師的稱讚有助於建立學生的自信心。)

eternity(n.)永恆、無窮的時間
eternal(adj.)永恆的
for eternity 永遠
seem like an eternity 彷彿過了很久
Waiting for the exam results seemed like an eternity.
(等待考試結果彷彿過了一輩子那麼久。)
The ancient Egyptians believed the soul would live for eternity.
(古埃及人相信靈魂會永遠存在。)

evacuate(v.)撤離、疏散
evacuation(n.)撤離、疏散
evacuate a building 疏散大樓人員
evacuation route 疏散路線
Residents were evacuated before the typhoon hit the coast.
(颱風襲擊海岸前，居民已被撤離。)
During the fire drill, all students evacuated the building in three minutes.
(在消防演習中，所有學生在三分鐘內疏散出大樓。)

evergreen(adj./n.)常綠的、常青的、常綠植物
(無詞性變化)
evergreen tree 常綠樹
evergreen forest 常綠林
Pine trees are evergreens that stay green throughout the year.
(松樹是一年四季都保持翠綠的常綠植物。)
Her songs have become evergreen classics loved by every generation.
(她的歌已成為受各世代喜愛的不朽經典。)

evoke(v.)喚起、引起
evocative(adj.)喚起回憶的
evoke memories 喚起回憶
evoke a response 引起反應
The smell of fresh bread evokes memories of my grandmother's kitchen.
(新鮮麵包的香味喚起我對奶奶廚房的回憶。)
The photograph evoked strong feelings of sadness among the viewers.
(這張照片在觀眾心中引起強烈的悲傷。)

examinee(n.)應試者、考生
examiner(n.)主考官
examination(n.)考試
examinee number 准考證號碼
examinees are required to 考生必須…
All examinees must bring their admission tickets to the test center.
(所有考生都必須攜帶准考證到考場。)
The examinees waited nervously outside the classroom.
(考生們緊張地在教室外等候。)

examiner(n.)主考官、檢查員
examine(v.)檢查、考試
examinee(n.)考生
driving examiner 駕照考官
medical examiner 法醫
The examiner asked me to describe a picture in English.
(主考官要我用英文描述一張圖片。)
The driving examiner said I had passed the road test.
(駕照考官說我通過了路考。)

excel(v.)擅長、勝過、表現優異
excellence(n.)卓越
excellent(adj.)極好的
excel in/at 擅長…
academic excellence 學業優異
She excels in both mathematics and music.
(她在數學和音樂方面都表現優異。)
The school is known for its academic excellence.
(這所學校以學業卓越聞名。)

excerpt(n./v.)摘錄、節錄
(無詞性變化)
an excerpt from 摘錄自…
read an excerpt 朗讀一段節錄
The teacher read us an excerpt from a famous novel.
(老師為我們朗讀了一部名著的節錄。)
This passage is excerpted from a speech by Martin Luther King Jr.
(這段文字節錄自馬丁·路德·金恩的演講。)

excess(adj./n.)過量的、多餘的、過量
excessive(adj.)過度的
excessively(adv.)過度地
in excess of 超過…
excess weight 多餘的體重
Drinking alcohol to excess can seriously damage your health.
(過量飲酒會嚴重損害健康。)
Passengers must pay extra for excess baggage.
(乘客的行李超重必須額外付費。)

exclusion(n.)排除、排斥
exclude(v.)排除
exclusive(adj.)獨家的、排外的
social exclusion 社會排斥
to the exclusion of 排除…、而不顧…
He studied computer science to the exclusion of everything else.
(他專心研讀資訊科學，其他什麼都不管。)
Social exclusion can make teenagers feel lonely and anxious.
(社交排擠可能使青少年感到孤單和焦慮。)

exempt(adj.)被免除的、豁免的
exemption(n.)免除、豁免
exempt from 免除…
tax-exempt 免稅的
Students with excellent grades are exempt from the final exam.
(成績優異的學生可以免考期末考。)
Books and newspapers are exempt from this new tax.
(書籍和報紙不需課徵這項新稅。)

exert(v.)運用、施加(影響、壓力)
exertion(n.)盡力、費力
exert influence 發揮影響力
exert pressure on 對…施壓
Parents exert a strong influence on their children's values.
(父母對孩子的價值觀有很大的影響。)
The group exerted pressure on the government to protect the forest.
(這個團體向政府施壓要求保護森林。)

expenditure(n.)支出、花費、經費
expend(v.)花費
expense(n.)費用
government expenditure 政府支出
reduce expenditure 減少支出
The city has increased its expenditure on public transportation.
(這座城市增加了在大眾運輸上的支出。)
We need to reduce expenditure if we want to save for the trip.
(如果我們想存錢去旅行，就得減少開支。)

expiration(n.)期滿、截止、到期
expire(v.)到期
expiration date 有效期限、到期日
upon expiration 到期時
Always check the expiration date before you buy milk.
(買牛奶前一定要檢查有效期限。)
Upon expiration of the contract, both sides may decide whether to renew it.
(合約到期時，雙方可決定是否續約。)

expire(v.)到期、失效
expiration(n.)到期
expired(adj.)過期的
expired food 過期食品
the visa expires 簽證到期
My passport will expire next month, so I need to renew it.
(我的護照下個月到期，所以需要換新。)
The store was fined for selling expired food to customers.
(這家店因販賣過期食品給顧客而被罰款。)

extract(n./v.)萃取物、摘錄、拔出、提取
extraction(n.)提取、拔出
extract information 擷取資訊
vanilla extract 香草精
The dentist had to extract two of my teeth.
(牙醫必須拔掉我兩顆牙。)
Oil is extracted from olives by pressing them.
(橄欖油是藉由壓榨橄欖萃取出來的。)

extracurricular(adj.)課外的
curriculum(n.)課程
extracurricular activities 課外活動
extracurricular clubs 課外社團
Joining extracurricular activities helps students develop leadership skills.
(參加課外活動有助於學生培養領導能力。)
Universities often look at applicants' extracurricular experience.
(大學常會參考申請者的課外經驗。)

eyelash(n.)睫毛
lash(n.)睫毛
long eyelashes 長睫毛
false eyelashes 假睫毛
The baby has long, curly eyelashes.
(那個嬰兒有又長又捲的睫毛。)
She put on false eyelashes before going on stage.
(她上台前戴上了假睫毛。)

eyelid(n.)眼皮、眼瞼
(無詞性變化)
double eyelid 雙眼皮
heavy eyelids 沉重的眼皮
My eyelids felt heavy after studying until midnight.
(念書念到半夜後，我的眼皮變得好沉重。)
She was born with double eyelids, just like her mother.
(她天生就是雙眼皮，跟她媽媽一樣。)

eyesight(n.)視力
(無詞性變化)
poor eyesight 視力不佳
lose one's eyesight 失明
Staring at screens for hours can harm your eyesight.
(長時間盯著螢幕可能傷害你的視力。)
My grandfather wears glasses because of his poor eyesight.
(我爺爺因為視力不好而戴眼鏡。)

fable(n.)寓言、虛構的故事
fabulous(adj.)極好的、驚人的
Aesop's Fables 伊索寓言
the moral of a fable 寓言的寓意
The fable of the tortoise and the hare teaches us not to be proud.
(龜兔賽跑的寓言教導我們不要驕傲。)
Many of Aesop's fables use animals to teach moral lessons.
(許多伊索寓言用動物來傳達道德教訓。)

faction(n.)派系、黨派
factional(adj.)派系的
rival factions 敵對派系
political faction 政治派系
The party split into two rival factions after the election.
(選舉後，這個政黨分裂成兩個敵對派系。)
Fighting between factions weakened the government.
(派系之間的鬥爭削弱了政府。)

Fahrenheit(n.)華氏溫度
(無詞性變化)
degrees Fahrenheit 華氏…度
Fahrenheit scale 華氏溫標
Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit.
(水在華氏212度沸騰。)
Americans usually measure temperature in Fahrenheit rather than Celsius.
(美國人通常用華氏而非攝氏來測量溫度。)

falter(v.)蹣跚、搖晃、支吾、衰退
(無詞性變化)
voice falters 聲音發顫
economy falters 經濟衰退
Her voice faltered as she told the sad story.
(她講述這個悲傷故事時聲音顫抖。)
Sales began to falter after the new competitor entered the market.
(新的競爭者進入市場後，銷售開始下滑。)

familiarity(n.)熟悉、通曉、親密
familiar(adj.)熟悉的
familiarize(v.)使熟悉
familiarity with 對…的熟悉
Familiarity breeds contempt. 熟悉生輕慢
Her familiarity with the local language made the trip much easier.
(她對當地語言的熟悉讓旅途輕鬆許多。)
New students should familiarize themselves with the school rules.
(新生應該熟悉校規。)

fascination(n.)著迷、魅力、吸引力
fascinate(v.)使著迷
fascinating(adj.)迷人的
fascination with 對…的著迷
hold a fascination for 對…有吸引力
His fascination with space led him to study astronomy.
(他對太空的著迷使他去攻讀天文學。)
Dinosaurs hold a special fascination for many children.
(恐龍對許多孩子有一種特別的吸引力。)

feasible(adj.)可行的、行得通的
feasibility(n.)可行性
a feasible plan 可行的計畫
feasibility study 可行性研究
We need to find a feasible solution to the parking problem.
(我們需要為停車問題找出可行的解決辦法。)
Building a bridge across the river is not economically feasible.
(在河上建橋在經濟上並不可行。)

feeble(adj.)虛弱的、微弱的、無力的
feebly(adv.)虛弱地
a feeble voice 微弱的聲音
a feeble excuse 站不住腳的藉口
The old man answered in a feeble voice.
(那位老人用微弱的聲音回答。)
Saying the dog ate your homework is a feeble excuse.
(說狗吃了你的作業是個站不住腳的藉口。)

feminine(adj./n.)女性的、有女人味的、陰性
femininity(n.)女性特質
feminine qualities 女性特質
feminine style 女性化的風格
The dress has a soft and feminine design.
(這件洋裝的設計柔美又有女人味。)
In French, every noun is either masculine or feminine.
(在法文中，每個名詞都分陽性或陰性。)

fertility(n.)肥沃、繁殖力、生育力
fertile(adj.)肥沃的
fertilize(v.)施肥、使受精
soil fertility 土壤肥沃度
fertility rate 生育率
Taiwan has one of the lowest fertility rates in the world.
(臺灣的生育率是全世界最低的之一。)
Farmers rotate crops to keep the fertility of the soil.
(農民輪作作物以保持土壤的肥沃。)

fertilizer(n.)肥料
fertilize(v.)施肥
fertile(adj.)肥沃的
chemical fertilizer 化學肥料
organic fertilizer 有機肥料
Many farmers now use organic fertilizer instead of chemicals.
(許多農民現在改用有機肥料而不用化學肥料。)
Too much fertilizer can pollute rivers and lakes.
(過多的肥料可能汙染河川和湖泊。)

fiancé(n.)未婚夫
fiance(n.)未婚夫(不加重音符號的寫法)
her fiancé 她的未婚夫
introduce one's fiancé 介紹未婚夫
She introduced her fiancé to her family at the dinner party.
(她在晚宴上把未婚夫介紹給家人。)
Her fiancé proposed to her on the beach at sunset.
(她的未婚夫在夕陽下的海灘向她求婚。)

fin(n.)鰭、鰭狀物
(無詞性變化)
shark fin 魚翅、鯊魚鰭
tail fin 尾鰭
Many people now refuse to eat shark fin soup to protect sharks.
(現在許多人為了保護鯊魚而拒吃魚翅湯。)
The fish moved its fins slowly as it swam near the rocks.
(那條魚在岩石附近游動時緩緩擺動牠的鰭。)

finite(adj.)有限的
infinite(adj.)無限的
finite resources 有限的資源
a finite number 有限的數量
Oil and coal are finite resources that will eventually run out.
(石油和煤炭是終究會耗盡的有限資源。)
We only have a finite amount of time, so let's use it wisely.
